1274-3490-5231-8333.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-5231-8333.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1637-4377-4423-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
You control at least four Islands.
1637-4377-4423-8344.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two other Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Aesi trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to draw Walk the Aeons from the top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

4677-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

1477-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
1477-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Repeat from step 3.

206-339-677-6495.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7228.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X instant and/or sorcery cards in all graveyards.
6495-6972-7228.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Academy Elite.
When Academy Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7228.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2728-4153-5256-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-4153-5256-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-4153-5256-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1671-3967-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

475-549-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-549-4186-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1526-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-7730.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1368-5295-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5295-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-7704.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-7704.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

2169-4613-5446-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
2169-4613-5446-7150.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens, which each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 4, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

4390-5078-6747-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-5078-6747-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

3967-4559-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
3967-4559-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury
Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2726-4668-7043.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
2726-4668-7043.description:
Cast Aang either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. When it enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Cast the Aang spell from exile by paying {0}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. Put either Aang token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aang token from step 5 enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6791-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
3259-6791-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6791-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-5231-5470-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

628-5231-7194.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1369-2691-7086.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
1369-2691-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Ilysian Caryatid.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Ilysian Caryatid's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Ilysian Caryatid's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Ilysian Caryatid's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

893-4853-5231.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.

1739-2034-2363-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3652-4053-5256-6989.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

339-677-969-2921.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

460-539-2691.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
460-539-2691.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Ilysian Caryatid.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1247-3918-6700.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sarevok's Tome's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
1247-3918-6700.notes: If you've completed a dungeon, you can instead use Sarevok's Tome's second ability once mana allows to cast your library.

880-3585-6664.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-3585-6664.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

510-2281-2292.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3951-4452-5231-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-4452-5231-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

277-1170-2733-5921-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

165-1069-4359-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-4359-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2-1308-5637.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1432-2821-3201-5448.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth of the Healing House does not have summoning sickness.
Arixmethes is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
Druid Class is level two.
1432-2821-3201-5448.description:
Activate Druid Class's third ability by paying {4}{G}, causing it to become level three.
Druid Class's third ability triggers, causing Minamo to become a */* creature with haste that's still a land.
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Minamo and Arixmethes.
Repeat from step 3.

575-2232-5518.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken nonartifact land.
575-2232-5518.description:
Activate Krosan Wayfarer by sacrificing it.
When Krosan Wayfarer dies, Yedora triggers, returning Krosan Wayfarer from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Krosan Wayfarer enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another nontoken nonartifact land from the battlefield to your hand. 
Activate Krosan Wayfarer by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Krosan Wayfarer ability from step 1, putting a nonartifact land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Krosan Wayfarer from the battlefield to your hand.
If the land entered the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast Krosan Wayfarer by paying {G}.
When Krosan Wayfarer enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers; choose not to return anything to your hand.
Repeat.

2882-4783-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is in the command zone.
Infinite Reflection attached to Hellkite Courser.
You have enough mana available to cast your commander, including commander tax, if applicable.
2882-4783-5147.description:
Cast your commander from the command zone by paying its mana cost plus commander tax, if applicable.
Your commander enters the battlefield as a copy of Hellkite Courser due to Infinite Reflection, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing your commander.
Choose to have your commander returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the trigger from step 2, returning your commander from the command zone to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with exactly one charge counter on it

1239-1636-2034-3492.description:
Activate Reckoner Bankbuster by paying {2}, tapping it, and removing a charge counter from it, drawing a card, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
When the Pilot enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers.
Holding priority, if Reckoner Bankbuster is not a creature, activate its crew ability by tapping the Pilot, causing Reckoner Bankbuster to become an artifact creatures until end of turn.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Reckoner Bankbuster.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pilot token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
